title: Canonical BOM picker revision is shown in the editor but silently disappears after save and UI reload
expected: Canonical Part Number lines must never present a transient Part Number revision; the editor state before save and after UI reload must be semantically identical.
actual: Picker insertion displayed Rev 1 and Rev 0.10. The save route correctly normalized canonical line revisions to null, so both revision fields became empty after UI reload.
fix: Canonical BOM insertion now stores revision=null from the first rendered state.
Legacy source revision remains supported and is explicitly labelled as source Drawing Rev.
Canonical inspector no longer shows a misleading Part Number revision field.
